title: Grogu Calms the Rancor
description: With his adopted father figure sidelined by the rancor, Grogu does what he does best: leaps into impossible danger to save the ones he loves. Grogu toddled forward toward the rancor, facing off against him in an attempt to soothe him. Where all of the other allies of Boba Fett failed to calm the raging monster, Grogu was able to tap into his teachings and Force ability to eschew his own fear and stop the monster's rampage. And after dealing with the beast, what better time would there be than to take a nap after the effort?
